title: Rimmon
sourceLines: -1. Father of the murderers of Ish-bosheth 2Sa 4:2,5,9
-2. A city south of Jerusalem Zec 14:10
.Allotted to the tribe of Judah Jos 15:32; Ne 11:29
.Later alloted to the tribe of Simeon Jos 19:7; 1Ch 4:32
-3. A city of the tribe of Zebulun 1Ch 6:77
-4. A rock in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin Jud 20:45,47; 21:13
